title: Cooling Cloth
description: Adds a Dry Cloth and Wet Cloth for those crazy summer heats! Made for ToughAsNails.
body:
# !!!TOUGH AS NAILS BY ADUBBZ IS REQUIRED FOR THIS MOD TO WORK, SPECIFICALLY v9.2.0.171!!!

This mod adds a Dry Cloth, that can be crafted with 9 string in a 3x3 Crafting grid.
![3x3 crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4483016294018aef877eb4dced4464c1e18a2b0b.png)

No, wet cloth cannot be crafted.

Take the Dry Cloth and dump it in any water source to turn it into a Wet Cloth. The Wet Cloth can be used to cool yourself down immediately.

You can use Mod Menu to customize the mod to your liking, or go to the config.json in your gams config folder.

Note: Season mods that don't support ToughAsNails may override the cooling effect. 

Note 2: The config.json may only populate once you customize every settings, save, then reset to default.

## ONLY MINECRAFT VERSION 1.20.1 HAS BEEN TESTED.

### Every change I make before stable release or stable fixes will come out as a public beta, listed as Beta under the releases, if you'd like to download them for your own personal testing before the stable comes out. I will be opening a suggestion box soon, whether by website or by email, so you guys can ask for future mods, OR give opinions or suggestions for existing mods.
